name: Agile Maneuvers
description: Use your Dex bonus instead of your Str bonus when calculating your Combat Maneuver Bonus.

name: Arcane Armor Training
description: As a swift action, reduce your arcane spell failure chance from armor by 10% for spells cast this round.

name: Arcane Armor Mastery
description: As a swift action, reduce your arcane spell failure chance from armor by 20% for spells cast this round. Replaces, and does not stack with, Arcane Armor Training.

name: Arcane Strike
description: As a swift action, your weapons deal +1 damage for 1 round and count as magic against damage reduction. The bonus rises by 1 per five caster levels, to +5 at 20th.

name: Armor Proficiency, Light
description: No attack penalty in light armor, and its armor check penalty applies only to Strength- and Dexterity-based skills. Everyone but monks, sorcerers, and wizards has this already.

name: Armor Proficiency, Medium
description: The same benefit as Light, for medium armor.

name: Armor Proficiency, Heavy
description: The same benefit as Light, for heavy armor.

name: Blind-Fight
description: Reroll melee miss chances from concealment once, and invisible attackers get no special advantage against you in melee.

name: Catch Off-Guard
description: No penalty for improvised melee weapons, and unarmed opponents are flat-footed against them.

name: Channel Smite
description: Spend a channel energy use as a swift action before a melee attack to add the channeled damage to a hit on an undead (positive) or living (negative) target. The target can make a Will save to halve it. A miss wastes the use.

name: Combat Expertise
description: Trade melee accuracy for a dodge bonus to AC. Switch it on when you declare a melee attack. (Combat maneuver checks aren't modeled yet.)

name: Improved Disarm
description: No attack of opportunity when you disarm. +2 on disarm checks and +2 CMD against being disarmed.

name: Greater Disarm
description: Another +2 on disarm checks. Weapons you knock away land 15 feet from their wielder.

name: Improved Feint
description: Feint in combat as a move action.

name: Greater Feint
description: Foes you feint lose their Dex bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Improved Trip
description: No attack of opportunity when you trip. +2 on trip checks and +2 CMD against being tripped.

name: Greater Trip
description: Another +2 on trip checks. Foes you trip provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: As a full-attack action, make one melee attack against every foe within reach.

name: Combat Reflexes
description: Make a number of additional attacks of opportunity per round equal to your Dex bonus, even while flat-footed.

name: Stand Still
description: Use a combat maneuver check as an attack of opportunity to stop a foe from moving for the rest of its turn.

name: Critical Focus
description: Bonus on rolls to confirm critical hits.

name: Bleeding Critical
description: Critical hits with slashing or piercing weapons cause bleeding.

name: Blinding Critical
description: Your critical hits permanently blind the target. A Fortitude save reduces this to dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

name: Critical Mastery
description: Apply the effects of two critical feats to a critical hit instead of one.

name: Deafening Critical
description: Your critical hits permanently deafen the target. A Fortitude save reduces this to 1 round.

name: Sickening Critical
description: Your critical hits make the target sickened for 1 minute.

name: Staggering Critical
description: Your critical hits stagger the target for 1d4+1 rounds. A Fortitude save reduces this to 1 round.

name: Stunning Critical
description: Your critical hits stun the target for 1d4 rounds. A Fortitude save reduces this to staggered for 1d4 rounds.

name: Tiring Critical
description: Your critical hits make the target fatigued.

name: Exhausting Critical
description: Your critical hits make the target exhausted.

name: Deadly Aim
description: Take a -1 penalty on ranged attack rolls for +2 damage. The trade grows as your base attack bonus rises.

name: Defensive Combat Training
description: Treat your total Hit Dice as your base attack bonus when calculating Combat Maneuver Defense.

name: Disruptive
description: Raises the DC for enemies to cast defensively within your threatened area.

name: Spellbreaker
description: Enemies in your threatened area that fail to cast defensively provoke attacks of opportunity from you.

name: Dodge
description: Dodge bonus to AC, lost whenever you lose your Dex bonus to AC.

name: Mobility
description: +4 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity caused by your movement.

name: Spring Attack
description: As a full-round action, move, make one melee attack without provoking from its target, and keep moving.

name: Wind Stance
description: If you move more than 5 feet, gain 20% concealment against ranged attacks for 1 round.

name: Lightning Stance
description: If you take two move actions or a withdraw, gain 50% concealment for 1 round.

name: Exotic Weapon Proficiency
subject: Weapon
description: Choose an exotic weapon. Attack with it without the non-proficiency penalty.

name: Improved Critical
subject: Weapon
description: Double the threat range of a chosen weapon.

name: Improved Initiative
description: Bonus on initiative checks.

name: Improved Unarmed Strike
description: You count as armed when unarmed, so you don't provoke attacks of opportunity, and you can deal lethal or nonlethal damage.

name: Deflect Arrows
description: With a free hand, once per round avoid the damage from one ranged attack you are aware of.

name: Snatch Arrows
description: When you deflect a ranged attack, you can catch the weapon instead. Thrown weapons can be thrown back.

name: Improved Grapple
description: No attack of opportunity when you grapple. +2 on grapple checks and +2 CMD against being grappled.

name: Greater Grapple
description: Another +2 on grapple checks. Maintaining a grapple is a move action.

name: Scorpion Style
description: An unarmed strike that reduces the target's speed to 5 feet unless it makes a Fortitude save.

name: Gorgon's Fist
description: An unarmed strike against a foe whose speed is reduced staggers it unless it makes a Fortitude save.

name: Medusa's Wrath
description: On a full attack including an unarmed strike, make two extra unarmed strikes against a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe.

name: Stunning Fist
description: Declare before an unarmed attack. A foe you damage must make a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round. Usable a limited number of times per day.

name: Improvised Weapon Mastery
description: No penalties with improvised weapons, damage one step higher, and a 19-20/x2 critical range.

name: Intimidating Prowess
description: Add your Strength modifier to Intimidate checks, in addition to Charisma.

name: Lunge
description: Increase your melee reach by 5 feet until the end of your turn, at a -2 penalty to AC until your next turn.

name: Martial Weapon Proficiency
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a martial weapon. Attack with it without the non-proficiency penalty.

name: Mounted Combat
description: Once per round, use Ride to negate a hit on your mount.

name: Mounted Archery
description: Halve the penalty for ranged attacks while mounted.

name: Ride-By Attack
description: While mounted and charging, move, strike, and keep moving, without provoking from the foe you attack.

name: Spirited Charge
description: Your mounted charge deals double damage with a melee weapon (triple with a lance).

name: Trample
description: While mounted, your overrun targets can't avoid you, and your mount gets a hoof attack against any foe you knock down.

name: Unseat
description: A lance charge that hits can also make a free bull rush to knock a mounted foe off its mount.

name: Point-Blank Shot
description: +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons against targets within 30 feet.

name: Far Shot
description: Take only a -1 penalty per range increment instead of -2.

name: Precise Shot
description: No -4 penalty for shooting or throwing at a foe engaged in melee.

name: Improved Precise Shot
description: Your ranged attacks ignore the AC bonus from anything less than total cover and the miss chance from anything less than total concealment.

name: Pinpoint Targeting
description: As a standard action, make one ranged attack against which the target gets no armor, natural armor, or shield bonus to AC. You can't have moved this round.

name: Shot on the Run
description: As a full-round action, move up to your speed and make one ranged attack at any point during the movement.

name: Rapid Shot
description: On a full attack with a ranged weapon, fire one extra time at your highest bonus, with a -2 penalty on all attacks.

name: Manyshot
description: On a full attack with a bow, your first attack fires two arrows. If it hits, both hit.

name: Power Attack
description: Trade melee accuracy for damage. The trade grows as your base attack bonus rises. (The extra damage for two-handed weapons isn't modeled yet.)

name: Cleave
description: After hitting a foe, make one extra attack against an adjacent foe, at the cost of AC.

name: Great Cleave
description: Like Cleave, but you can keep chaining attacks to adjacent foes.

name: Improved Bull Rush
description: No attack of opportunity when you bull rush. +2 on bull rush checks and +2 CMD against being bull rushed.

name: Greater Bull Rush
description: Another +2 on bull rush checks. Foes you bull rush provoke attacks of opportunity from your allies.

name: Improved Overrun
description: No attack of opportunity when you overrun. +2 on overrun checks and +2 CMD against being overrun. Targets can't choose to avoid you.

name: Greater Overrun
description: Another +2 on overrun checks. Foes you knock prone by overrunning provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Improved Sunder
description: No attack of opportunity when you sunder. +2 on sunder checks and +2 CMD against having your gear sundered.

name: Greater Sunder
description: Another +2 on sunder checks. Excess damage from destroying an item carries over to its wielder.

name: Quick Draw
description: Draw a weapon as a free action, and throw weapons at your full rate of attacks.

name: Rapid Reload
subject: Weapon
description: Choose hand, light, or heavy crossbow. Reload it much faster (a free action for hand and light, a move action for heavy). Needs proficiency with that crossbow, which isn't checked yet.

name: Shield Proficiency
description: A shield's armor check penalty applies only to Strength- and Dexterity-based skills. Most martial classes have this already.

name: Improved Shield Bash
description: Keep your shield's AC bonus when you shield bash.

name: Shield Slam
description: Foes hit by your shield bash are also hit with a free bull rush.

name: Shield Master
description: No two-weapon penalties when attacking with a shield, and its enhancement bonus applies to attack and damage.

name: Shield Focus
description: Increase the AC bonus from any shield you use by 1.

name: Greater Shield Focus
description: Another +1 to the AC bonus from any shield you use.

name: Tower Shield Proficiency
description: A tower shield's armor check penalty applies only to Strength- and Dexterity-based skills.

name: Simple Weapon Proficiency
description: Attack with simple weapons without penalty. Every class has this already except druids, monks, and wizards.

name: Step Up
description: When an adjacent foe takes a 5-foot step away, take a 5-foot step as an immediate action to stay adjacent.

name: Strike Back
description: Ready an action to make a melee attack against a foe that attacks you from outside your reach.

name: Throw Anything
description: No penalty for improvised ranged weapons, and a +1 circumstance bonus on attacks with thrown splash weapons.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: Reduce the penalties for fighting with two weapons (primary hand by 2, off hand by 6).

name: Double Slice
description: Add your full Strength bonus to damage with your off-hand weapon.

name: Two-Weapon Rend
description: If you hit a foe with both weapons, deal an extra 1d10 plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier, once per round.

name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
description: A second off-hand attack, at a -5 penalty.

name: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting
description: A third off-hand attack, at a -10 penalty.

name: Two-Weapon Defense
description: +1 shield bonus to AC while wielding two weapons (+2 when fighting defensively or using total defense).

name: Vital Strike
description: With the attack action, make one attack at your highest bonus that rolls the weapon's damage dice twice.

name: Improved Vital Strike
description: As Vital Strike, but the weapon's damage dice are rolled three times.

name: Greater Vital Strike
description: As Vital Strike, but the weapon's damage dice are rolled four times.

name: Weapon Finesse
description: Use your Dex modifier instead of Str on attack rolls with light weapons, elven curve blades, rapiers, whips, and spiked chains.

name: Weapon Focus
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon. +1 bonus on attack rolls with it. (Weapon proficiency isn't checked yet.)

name: Dazzling Display
description: As a full-round action with your Weapon Focus weapon, make an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet.

name: Shatter Defenses
description: Shaken, frightened, or panicked foes you hit are flat-footed to your attacks until the end of your next turn.

name: Deadly Stroke
description: As a standard action, strike a stunned or flat-footed foe for double damage and 1 point of Constitution bleed.

name: Greater Weapon Focus
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon you have Weapon Focus in. Another +1 bonus on attack rolls with it.

name: Penetrating Strike
description: Attacks with your Weapon Focus weapons ignore up to 5 points of damage reduction (not DR without a type).

name: Greater Penetrating Strike
description: Attacks with your Weapon Focus weapons ignore up to 10 points of damage reduction (5 against DR without a type).

name: Weapon Specialization
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon you have Weapon Focus in. +2 bonus on damage rolls with it.

name: Greater Weapon Specialization
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon you have Weapon Specialization in. Another +2 bonus on damage rolls with it.
